name: Discord - Minecraft Chat Bridge
author: chatbridge@example.com
description: Node.js Discord-Minecraft chat bridge with RCON and webhook support.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Your Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal

variables.name: Discord Webhook URL
variables.description: Webhook URL to relay Minecraft chat to Discord

variables.name: Discord Chat Channel ID
variables.description: The Discord channel ID where Minecraft chat will be relayed

variables.name: Discord Log Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional webhook URL for server logs and crash alerts

variables.name: Discord Admin IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Discord user IDs with admin permissions

variables.name: Discord Admin Role ID
variables.description: Discord role ID for admin notifications (e.g., crash alerts)

variables.name: Pterodactyl API Key
variables.description: API key for authenticating with the Pterodactyl Panel

variables.name: Pterodactyl API URL
variables.description: URL of the Pterodactyl Panel (e.g., http://localhost or https://panel.example.com)

variables.name: Pterodactyl Server ID
variables.description: UUID of the Minecraft server in Pterodactyl

variables.name: RCON Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the Minecraft server for RCON

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port of the Minecraft server

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON password for the Minecraft server

variables.name: Log File Path
variables.description: Path to Minecraft server log file (relative to server root)

variables.name: Container Port
variables.description: Port for internal bot communication (not exposed externally)
